description: This file defines the 'LocalDispatcher' interface, which serves as the main API for the service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes method signatures for running services synchronously and asynchronously, scheduling jobs, managing callbacks, and accessing related components like JobManager, Delegator, and Security.

methods.name: disableEcas
methods.description: Disables the execution of Service Engine Condition Actions (SECAs).

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
methods.description: Checks if SECAs are currently disabled.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with the given name and context, returning the result.

methods.name: runSync with timeout and transaction
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with specified timeout and transaction requirements.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, passing a requester to receive the result.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and returns a waiter object to wait for the result.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback listener for a specific service.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified time with recurrence options.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Adds a rollback service to the current transaction.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Adds a commit service to the current transaction.

methods.name: getJobManager
methods.description: Returns the JobManager associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getJMSListeneFactory
methods.description: Returns the JmsListenerFactory managing message listeners.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this local dispatcher.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Returns the DispatchContext created by this dispatcher.
